terms.gloss: the plaintiff in a private suit
evidence: Cic. Rosc. Com. 42: quis erat petītor? Fannius: quis reus? Flāvius (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The claimant in a private or civil suit; in a criminal case the one who brings the charge is accūsātor (Lewis & Short).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 196.
